title: Agentic Commerce Protocol — overview
quote: An open standard for programmatic commerce flows between buyers, AI agents, and businesses. Stripe and OpenAI created ACP as a collaborative initiative. Apache 2.0 license. Stripe is the first compatible PSP with its Shared Payment Token. REST and MCP compatible.

title: agentic-commerce-protocol/agentic-commerce-protocol — repository
quote: The Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) is an interaction model and open standard for connecting buyers, their AI agents, and businesses to complete purchases seamlessly. The specification is maintained by OpenAI and Stripe and is currently in beta. spec/ holds dated snapshots 2025-09-29 (initial), 2025-12-12 (fulfillment), 2026-01-16 (capability negotiation), 2026-01-30 (extensions, discounts, payment handlers), 2026-04-17 (cart, feed, orders, authentication, MCP). rfcs/ contains rfc.agentic_checkout, rfc.delegate_payment, rfc.payment_handlers, rfc.seller_backed_payment_handler, rfc.capability_negotiation, rfc.discount_extension, rfc.discovery, rfc.extensions, rfc.intent_traces, rfc.marketing_consent, rfc.orders. docs/ contains governance, mcp-binding, operating-model, principles-mission, sep-cart-capability, sep-guidelines.

title: Delegated Payment Spec
quote: POST /agentic_commerce/delegate_payment. OpenAI initiates by sending payment_method (card with type/number/expiry), allowance object (reason one_time, max_amount, currency, expiry), risk_signals (type/score/action), and metadata. The PSP returns a vault token (format vt_…) that is single-use and set with allowances, scoped to prevent use beyond the delegated payment's constraints. PSP-returned credentials are narrowly scoped and cannot be used outside the defined limits of the user-approved purchase.

title: Key concepts — Agentic Commerce
quote: ChatGPT collects buyer, fulfillment, and payment information from the user and calls the merchant's Agentic Commerce Protocol endpoints. The merchant performs validation, determines fulfillment options, calculates taxes, analyzes payment signals, and processes payments on their own systems. The PSP responds with a payment token that OpenAI passes on to the merchant to complete the payment. The Agentic Checkout Spec enables ChatGPT to act as the customer's AI agent and renders a checkout experience embedded in ChatGPT's UI. Instant Checkout in ChatGPT is currently available to approved partners.

title: openapi.delegate_payment.yaml — 2026-04-17
quote: POST /agentic_commerce/delegate_payment. Parameters: Authorization (bearer), Content-Type, Accept-Language, User-Agent, Idempotency-Key, Request-Id, Signature (Detached JSON signature for request verification), Timestamp (ISO 8601 timestamp for request timing validation), API-Version. Tokenizes a credential for controlled usage by the merchant's PSP per the Allowance constraints. Exactly one credential type is currently supported: card.

title: Buy it in ChatGPT: Instant Checkout and the Agentic Commerce Protocol
quote: OpenAI launch post introducing Instant Checkout in ChatGPT, built on the Agentic Commerce Protocol developed jointly with Stripe (referenced indirectly via WebSearch landing-page snippet; direct WebFetch returned HTTP 403, treat as access_limited).

title: Agentic Commerce Protocol — Stripe Documentation
quote: ACP is an open standard created by Stripe, OpenAI, and Meta that defines how AI agents interact with businesses to complete purchases on behalf of buyers. Building blocks: agentic checkout, cart and feed, delegate payment, delegate authentication, orders and webhooks.

title: Search result claiming ACP is created by Stripe, OpenAI, and Meta
quote: Multiple third-party writeups summarising AP that surface the Stripe docs page wording 'ACP is an open standard created by Stripe, OpenAI, and Meta'. The canonical agenticcommerce.dev and the GitHub README list only OpenAI and Stripe as Founding Maintainers; Meta is not in the canonical maintainers list, so this is treated as a conflicting third-party report.
